_: Named views for scripts/shot.mjs --view <name> and scripts/compare.mjs. Coordinates are scene metres: x east, y up, z south of the middle of cầu Trường Tiền; the river is at y 0 and the city's ground at y 2.6 (LAND_Y). A view is either a fixed camera (camera: { pos, target }) or an arrival: the camera starts at start, the visitor's pick of place runs (the same call a search result or a label makes), and frames are taken that many seconds into it. viewport is CSS pixels at device scale 1; look real|ink; time 0 morning, 1 afternoon, 2 evening; reducedMotion emulates prefers-reduced-motion. Add a view when a task needs one; change an existing view only on purpose, since earlier captures stop being comparable.

ngo-mon-arrival.note: A visitor over Trường Tiền searches for Ngọ Môn and flies there; landscape desktop window.

truong-tien-river-level.note: Cầu Trường Tiền from a boat on the Hương, downstream (east) of the bridge, looking upstream.

junction-west-lanes.note: A junction west of the citadel's south-east corner, from above at an angle: lane markings, medians and pavement where four roads meet.

junction-bridge-west.note: Straight down on the brick bridge over the citadel moat at x -464, z -49, where its deck meets the street.

courtyard-vac-ta-vu.note: Close view of the bronze cauldron (vạc đồng) before Tả Vu in the Cần Chánh court, from the axis side (src/landmarks/courtyard.js).

courtyard-cannons-quang-duc.note: The five holy cannons (Cửu vị thần công, Ngũ hành) in their house inside Cửa Quảng Đức, from in front of the muzzles (src/landmarks/courtyard.js).

courtyard-cannons-the-nhon.note: The four holy cannons (Cửu vị thần công, Tứ thời) in their house inside Cửa Thể Nhơn, from in front of the muzzles (src/landmarks/courtyard.js).

thaihoa-kylan-front.note: The front of điện Thái Hòa from Long Trì just west of the axis: the pair of bronze kỳ lân at the foot of the middle flight and the one vạc on the hall's left, the east (src/landmarks/places/thaihoa.js).

themieu-kylan-kiosk.note: The east bronze kỳ lân of Thế Miếu's court in its metal kiosk (thiết đình), from the walk side (src/landmarks/places/themieu.js).

thaihoa-open-doors.note: Into điện Thái Hòa through the three open middle front bays, from Đan Bệ on the axis: the bronze cranes on tortoises either side of the throne bay (src/landmarks/places/thaihoa.js).

ngo-mon-dich-mon.note: Standing in Ngọ Môn's forecourt between the wings, at eye height, looking at the west wing's inner face: Tả Dịch Môn and the west Giáp Môn from the side.

ngu-binh-north.note: Núi Ngự Bình from the north, over the An Cựu quarter, looking south along the Citadel's axis at the flat top.
